title: Ship a change to this repository
purpose: Get a change from a working tree into main with every check it claims to have passed actually evaluated by something other than the party claiming it
trigger: A change is ready to publish — not after it has been published, which is too late for two of the three steps

inputs.name: change
inputs.description: what the change is for, in one line, so a divergence later reads as something other than 'a commit'

steps.name: prove-it-here
steps.purpose: Establish, before anything leaves this machine, that the suite and the identity scan pass
steps.definition_of_done: The suite is green on every backend the environment can reach, leakguard exits zero, and the tree is committed

steps.name: publish
steps.purpose: Move the change to the remote that other people and other machines read
steps.definition_of_done: The remote's main is the commit that was proven in step 1, not a near relative of it

gate.check: git fetch origin --quiet && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"

steps.name: confirm-what-the-push-started
steps.purpose: Read the verdict of every job the push triggered, rather than the headline of whichever run is newest
steps.definition_of_done: Every job of the CI workflow for this exact commit concluded success — job by job, workflow named explicitly
